title: Cover and Cipher
author: Yara Thackeray
blurb: Freya Ravensworth, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
